verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks. He calls to the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
God shines out from Zion, the city of perfect beauty.
Our God is coming, and he will not be silent. A fire burns up everything in front of him. A great storm rages around him.
He calls to the skies above and to the earth, so he can judge his people.
He says, "Gather my faithful people to me, those who made a covenant with me by offering sacrifices."
The skies announce that he is fair, because God himself is the judge. Selah.
"Listen, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will give evidence against you. I am God, your God.
I am not blaming you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are always in front of me.
I do not need a bull from your barn or goats from your pens.
Every animal in the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.
I know every bird in the mountains. All the wild animals in the fields are mine.
If I were hungry, I would not tell you, because the world is mine and everything in it.
Do I eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
Bring thankfulness to God as your sacrifice. Keep the promises you made to the Most High.
Call to me when you are in trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honour me."
But God says to the wicked, "What right do you have to recite my laws or talk about my covenant?
You hate my correction and throw my words behind you.
When you see a thief, you join him. You spend time with people who are unfaithful in marriage.
Your mouth is quick to speak evil. Your tongue makes up lies.
You sit and speak against your brother. You spread lies about your own mother's son.
You did these things and I was silent, so you thought I was just like you. But now I will correct you and lay out the charges against you right in front of you.
Think about this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces and no one will rescue you.
Whoever brings thankfulness as a sacrifice honours me. To the one who follows the right path, I will show God's saving help."
